name: fast-corner-carry-v1
purpose: remove discontinuous over-braking and sustain more speed through obstacle-free curves without weakening the proven obstacle-plus-hairpin safety envelope

evidence.video_finding: Track2 loses visible progress in its long U-turn and track3 slows in its S-curve and obstacle-adjacent bend. The videos contain no speed or pedal telemetry, so they motivate a curve-speed experiment but cannot prove braking causality.
evidence.code_finding: The control drops from target68 to at most48 on any non-straight frame; at sweep6 it commands target34 and brake0.28 at speed60. This is direct evidence of a discontinuous and conservative curve envelope.
evidence.prior_safety_finding: Lowering the obstacle-plus-hairpin cap from30 to24 did not fix the seed21 failure and added low-speed lap loss on seed42. Historical seed11,17,21 failures involved obstacle-bearing hairpins, so that cap and its miss latch remain frozen.
evidence.interpretation: Primary-source racing control work supports curvature-conditioned velocity and a shared longitudinal/lateral tire-force budget. The camera sweep is only a bounded image-space proxy, so this experiment uses a monotone inverse-square-root schedule and attenuates throttle as requested steering approaches its limit.

single_factor.name: friction-aware obstacle-free curve speed envelope
single_factor.target_formula: clip(68/sqrt(1+0.10*sweep),40,64) only when the inherited exact-straight predicate is false and both current obstacle and obstacle miss latch are clear
single_factor.effective_target: the final target after the inherited abs(steering)>0.28 cap, so strong steering continues to impose target44
unchanged: current obstacle targets47/40, obstacle+sweep>=6 target30, miss-latch target and all associated parent pedals
road and obstacle perception, steering law, steering limits and steering slew
lost-road behavior, observation/action interface and official environment files
model.pt, DrQ, explicit-export and HAIC policy routes
all track-id, seed, coordinate, elapsed-time and progress independence

static_and_synthetic: Bare state-dict routing selects only the candidate; explicit export, DrQ and HAIC routes remain unchanged.
Obstacle-free curve targets match the registered inverse-square-root formula and are monotone within40..64; sweep6 target is approximately53.7587 rather than34.
Obstacle-free curve throttle follows the three registered branches and steering attenuation; gas and brake never overlap.
Obstacle-free curve braking begins strictly above effective target+2, is monotone and never exceeds0.18.
The post-adjustment strong-steering cap44 is honored by pedal control rather than bypassed by the earlier command target.
Current obstacle, every miss-latch frame and reacquisition remain action-identical to the control for identical controller state and observation.
Steering remains exactly equal to the control across directed and randomized tests; invalid input, road loss and reset remain inherited.
Affected/local/submission contract tests and an isolated exact-file package smoke pass.

future_environment_gate.required_before_claim: After governance restoration, compare candidate and exact control on preregistered unused multi-track geometry seeds. Completion rate, DNF, collision and worst progress may not regress before lap time is considered.
future_environment_gate.objective: Reduce curve time and move each evaluation track toward the low-20-second range; no static implementation or consumed video can establish a lap-time result.

abort: Any runtime condition uses track id, seed, map identity, coordinate, time, progress or evaluation filename.
Any current-obstacle or miss-latch target, pedal, steering or pass-side behavior differs from the control.
Any action is non-finite/out of range, gas and brake overlap, steering differs from control, package/interface gate fails, or relevant regression fails.
Any environment execution, training, submission, SOTA promotion or performance claim occurs while governance documents remain absent.
Any frozen environment/model/DrQ/active-study artifact, user video or root submission.zip changes.
compliance_blockers: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf are absent.
The competition website is inaccessible; the official participant repository remains available and unchanged.
Only source, synthetic, unit and isolated package validation is authorized.
